messages.subject: Hartwell v Cryovance - Claim issued and served (CL-2026-000214)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Whitlock,

Proceedings have been issued. By way of service we attach the sealed Particulars of Claim and the Schedule of Loss. As you will see, the total claimed is 3,440,397 (direct losses of 3,286,000 plus interest of 154,397 to the date of issue). We look forward to the Defence in due course.

Yours faithfully,
Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
